Card Q&A.a: No, this card's [When Digivolving] effect and inherited effect don't allow ignoring color requirements, so you can only use cards that meet the color requirements.
Card Q&A.q: Can I ignore the color requirements when I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect or inherited effect in order to use an Option card with [Plug-In] in its name or a yellow Option card?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may use 1 Option card that is yellow or has [Plug-In] in its name from your hand with the use cost reduced by 2.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Sakuyamon] in its name, you may use 1 Option card that is yellow or has [Plug-In] in its name from your hand with the use cost reduced by 2.
